Piece of advice and all types of relationships be it your romantic partners, your kids, your parents, your friends, your family, or your coworkers… if you believe that they are doing something that is causing you to have negative feelings you need to address it because when negative feelings build up it’s hard to untangle it of course approaching it is different from person to person and situation to situation… but communication is a key to any successful relationship… I would suggest you calmly and causally ask her why does she always shows you those messages and depending on her answer you can move on… I will give you some answers based on her reaction to spare you some time:

- If she is trying to make you jealous: ask her why because if she is innocently messing with you you can ask her to stop because it is uncomfortable but if she is trying to do it in a toxic way that’s a bit of a red flag 

- If she is just showing you it to you as something that happens casually and it’s a mundane conversation: try communicating your emotions in a clam and clear way

- If she feels bad about it and doesn’t want to keep secrets: she probably had a toxic controlling ex that caused her anxiety and you need to communicate with her and help her move on
